name: Kottu Roti
description: A legendary Sri Lankan street food favorite made of chopped godamba roti, vegetables, eggs, and your choice of meat, tossed briskly on a hot metal griddle with aromatic spices.

name: Fried Rice
description: Fluffy basmati rice wok-fried to perfection with farm-fresh eggs, crisp seasonal vegetables, spring onions, and a special blend of savory Asian sauces.

name: Veg Sub
description: A wholesome submarine sandwich packed with a crunchy medley of fresh garden vegetables, melted cheese, and a signature house dressing tucked inside a freshly baked crusty roll.

name: Watalappan
description: A rich, traditional Sri Lankan coconut custard pudding sweetened with pure jaggery and delicately spiced with cardamom, nutmeg, and cashew nuts.

name: Iced Milo
description: An iconic campus refreshment—chilled, creamy, and deeply chocolatey malt beverage served ice-cold to beat the tropical heat.
